w:r.w:t: Ajay Kumar Garg University, Ghaziabad is committed to promoting access to quality education by supporting talented and deserving students.
The University believes that financial limitations should not prevent capable students from achieving their academic goals.
To encourage excellence, the University offers various scholarships and financial assistance schemes based on academic merit and notable achievements in sports and cultural activities.
Depending on eligibility, students may receive full or partial tuition fee waivers, enabling them to pursue their education in a motivating and supportive environment.

Scholarships for Wards of Alumni of
Students who are wards of alumni of Ajay Kumar Garg University shall be eligible for
an additional 10% relaxation in the admission merit criteria or a 10% tuition fee waiver in the first-year fee

Scholarships for Siblings of Currently Enrolled Students of
Students who are siblings of currently enrolled students at Ajay Kumar Garg University shall be eligible for
an additional 5% relaxation in the admission merit criteria or a 5% tuition fee waiver in the first-year fee
Scholarships for Wards of Employees of
Students who are wards of employees of Ajay Kumar Garg University shall be eligible for
an additional 10% relaxation in the admission merit criteria or a 5% tuition fee waiver in each year of study
, subject to verification of employment records and University policies.
